Subject: Request: co-sponsorship for SI-led PoC trial

Hi Lauren / Marcus,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. EdgeScale is lined up to run a 6-week SI-led PoC with a strategic retail customer. Our SI partner is requesting a modest sponsorship to cover inference costs during the pilot so they can demonstrate the integrated experience without the early cost friction.

High level ask: $10k in trial credits (usable over 6 weeks), ability to extend the trial by 2 weeks if adoption signals look good, and a short activation window ahead of 12/15 so the SI can complete onboarding before Holiday cadence.

Attached is a short PoC outline (initial-poc-outline.pdf) with estimates on token usage, concurrency needs, and target test cases.

Next steps we need from Redwood: confirmation on whether co-sponsored credits are OK under the reseller agreement, a PO or invoice flow we can present to the SI, and any compliance notes we should pass to the customer.

Can you confirm feasibility this week? The SI wants to schedule a kickoff for 12/10.

Thanks,
Devon Price
Head of Partnerships
EdgeScale

Devon — appreciate the clear ask and timeline. We're generally open to co-sponsoring SI-led pilots when there are realistic production signals. A few items before I can greenlight:

- Confirmed token usage profile (peak concurrency + daily tokens) so we can size the allocation.
- Signed SOW or one-page statement from the SI with acceptance criteria (helps Product/CS measure impact).
- PO flow: do you need Redwood to invoice the SI directly, or will EdgeScale route funds and we bill EdgeScale? If EdgeScale pays, we need a PO + estimated billing cadence.

Looping in Vanessa (partner ops) to detail the ops checklist and provide the PO template and activation steps. Marcus, FYI on commercial terms — this looks like it could convert into a broader co-sell motion if the retail customer progresses.

If we can get SOW + token estimate by EOD Wednesday (12/02), I will push for a fast-track approval and draft the activation instructions.

Best,
